strings: r_c0 has noticed m_c getting quieter and quieter as time goes on. Coming over to check on {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/discover/discovers} that m_c's voice has left {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c's awkward volume control has faded away until all {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} words are just too hard for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates to hear.
After struggling for so long to be heard, m_c has settled into a calm silence.
